# Arte Bianca

> Arte Bianca is an Italian restaurant & pizzeria with two locations in the province of Antwerp, Belgium: a pizzeria in Tisselt (Willebroek) and a restaurant & pizzeria in Wintam (Bornem), opened on 8 October 2026. Neapolitan pizza with long-fermented dough, homemade lasagne, pasta and Italian desserts, made with selected Italian ingredients. Online table reservations and online takeaway orders via artebianca.be.

## Locations

- [Pizzeria Arte Bianca Tisselt](https://artebianca.be/tisselt-willebroek/): Hoogstraat 50, 2830 Tisselt (Willebroek), Belgium. Phone +32 472 50 44 57. Open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday to Sunday 17:00–21:00; closed Wednesday. Neapolitan pizza, starters, desserts; dine-in, reservations and takeaway.
- [Ristorante & Pizzeria Arte Bianca Wintam](https://artebianca.be/wintam-bornem/): Egied de Jonghestraat 165, 2880 Bornem (Wintam), Belgium. Phone +32 494 06 95 71. Open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday 17:00–21:30; Friday and Saturday 17:00–22:00; Sunday 12:00–21:00; closed Wednesday. Italian restaurant and pizzeria: pizza, pasta, lasagne, desserts; dine-in, reservations, takeaway, business lunch and catering.

## Services

- [Table reservation](https://artebianca.be/reservation/): online booking for both locations.
- [Online takeaway ordering](https://artebianca.be/): order online for pickup; orders open from 15:00 (Wintam on Sunday from 11:00).
- [Business Lunch Wintam](https://artebianca.be/business-lunch/): Italian lunch for offices, Menu Pizza €18 or Menu Restaurant €22 per person (main course, dessert, drink), from 10 people, picked up hot at the Wintam restaurant on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday between 11:30 and 13:00, to be requested at least 24 hours in advance.
- [Shop](https://artebianca.be/shop/): Italian products.
- [Gallery](https://artebianca.be/gallery/): photos of the dishes and the restaurants.

## Languages

The website is available in Dutch ([artebianca.be/nl/](https://artebianca.be/nl/)), Italian, French and English.
